title: Daily active users top 10 million, with average daily consumption of 100 trillion tokens: Tencent WorkBuddy delivers its anniversary scorecard
excerpt: Tencent today released its Q3 2026 earnings report, which disclosed the latest figures for WorkBuddy: as of early November, this AI assistant's daily active use
content_html:
Tencent today released its Q3 2026 earnings report, which disclosed the latest figures for WorkBuddy: as of early November, this AI assistant's daily active users had surpassed 10 million, and its average daily Token calls exceeded 100 trillion, making it the AI product with the highest average daily Token usage among Chinese large language models. Since its launch in March this year, it has completed more than 100 major version updates, with an iteration speed visible for all to see.

The enterprise side is also making aggressive gains

Beyond its strong consumer momentum, its B2B business is not lagging behind either. Just two months after the open platform launched, the Buddy app has already covered 55 professional scenarios and more than 30 vertical sectors, with a presence in finance, law, healthcare, education, public welfare, design, SaaS, and more. The enterprise edition has been deployed across more than 50 industries and achieved 50% penetration among China's Top 500 Enterprises—a rather rare achievement for a product that has been on the market for less than a year.

The new model supplying ammunition to WorkBuddy is just as formidable: on its first day, Hy4 flash exceeded 50 trillion Token calls, setting a first-day call record for the Hunyuan series. It also topped the OpenRouter LLM daily leaderboard and became a preferred lightweight model frequently used by developers worldwide; within WorkBuddy, its first-day call volume was also 10 times that of Hy4 preview on its launch day. With models, products, and ecosystem all advancing together, Tencent's AI hand is growing stronger and stronger.
